name: muesli
author: rcasaca
description: Recording indicator for muesli, the Granola-style meeting transcriber. Shows idle / meeting detected / recording, with click actions to start, stop, enhance and open the TUI.

barWidget.description: Meeting recorder status: left-click start/stop, right-click enhance latest, middle-click open the TUI.

schema.label: Poll interval (s)
schema.description: How often to ask the muesli daemon for its status.

schema.label: Hide while idle
schema.description: Only show the widget when a meeting is detected or a recording is running.

schema.label: Hide when the daemon is not running
